reserveReview.rationale: Origin states that OUSD became 100% USDC-backed after the November 2025 simplification and deploys the collateral across Morpho lending and Curve liquidity provision. The original standing-envelope review replaced an unsupported 90/10 estimate with one aggregate USDC protocol-position basket. The itemized Origin API recovered on 2026-10-01 now publishes per-strategy USDC amounts and available liquidity; the aggregate row is retained to match the live adapter's existing USDC source key.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Standing 100% USDC collateral envelope with itemized strategy amounts in Origin's 2026-10-01T16:47:47.582Z API snapshot; aggregate source-key mapping retained
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The full basket is USDC collateral.
